cases.name: Aileen Martinez
cases.about:
Aileen was a beauty school student and was an aspiring cosmetologist. She previously attended a music school in Miami for four years  and performed with local bands.

“As you can imagine, her family is dealing with a tremendous grief, having lost their eldest daughter so unexpectedly,” wrote Rachel Tracey, the organizer of the (Go Fund Me) fundraiser.

“And true to the meaning of her name, was the shining light in her family’s life,” Tracey said.

“She loved rock n’ roll, thrift shopping, playing computer video games and discovering new makeup tricks. Her favorite color was jade green, which is fitting because it symbolizes peace & calm and love & harmony, all traits that represent Aileen.”
cases.narrative: On 1/27/2026, she was found inside a white SUV at the parking lot of the Aveda Institute of South Florida in Davie, Fla., just after 2 p.m. when police responded to a shooting steps from the school.
